components.templateData:
<!-- Group container rectangle -->
<svg:rect
  class="group-container"
  [class.group-selected]="selected()"
  [attr.width]="node().width"
  [attr.height]="node().height"
  rx="8"
  ry="8"
/>

<!-- Group label -->
<svg:text
  class="group-label"
  [attr.x]="node().width / 2"
  [attr.y]="20"
  dominant-baseline="middle"
  text-anchor="middle"
>
  {{ node().label }}
</svg:text>

<!-- Preview container with clipping -->
<svg:defs>
  <svg:clipPath [attr.id]="'clip-' + node().id">
    <svg:rect
      [attr.x]="20"
      [attr.y]="30"
      [attr.width]="node().width - 40"
      [attr.height]="node().height - 50"
      rx="4"
    />
  </svg:clipPath>
</svg:defs>

<!-- Preview: detailed (scaled child nodes) or generic placeholder -->
<svg:g
  class="group-preview"
  [attr.clip-path]="'url(#clip-' + node().id + ')'"
>
  @if (showPlaceholder()) {
    <!-- Generic placeholder when scale is too small -->
    <svg:g class="group-preview-placeholder" [attr.transform]="'translate(' + (node().width / 2 - 24) + ',' + (30 + (node().height - 50) / 2 - 24) + ')'">
      <svg:rect x="0" y="0" width="12" height="12" rx="2" class="preview-node" />
      <svg:rect x="14" y="0" width="12" height="12" rx="2" class="preview-node" />
      <svg:rect x="0" y="14" width="12" height="12" rx="2" class="preview-node" />
      <svg:rect x="14" y="14" width="12" height="12" rx="2" class="preview-node" />
    </svg:g>
  } @else {
    <svg:g [attr.transform]="getPreviewTransform()">
      <!-- Links first (behind nodes) -->
      @for (link of getChildLinks(); track link.id) {
        <svg:path
          class="preview-link"
          [attr.d]="getLinkPathD(link)"
          fill="none"
        />
      }
      <!-- Nodes with original shapes -->
      @for (childNode of getChildNodes(); track childNode.id) {
        <svg:g [attr.transform]="'translate(' + childNode.x + ',' + childNode.y + ')'">
          @switch (childNode.shape) {
            @case ('roundedRect') {
              <svg:rect
                class="preview-node"
                [attr.width]="childNode.width"
                [attr.height]="childNode.height"
                [attr.rx]="childNode.width / 4"
                [attr.ry]="childNode.height / 4"
              />
            }
            @case ('circle') {
              <svg:ellipse
                class="preview-node"
                [attr.cx]="childNode.width / 2"
                [attr.cy]="childNode.height / 2"
                [attr.rx]="childNode.width / 2"
                [attr.ry]="childNode.height / 2"
              />
            }
            @case ('ellipse') {
              <svg:ellipse
                class="preview-node"
                [attr.cx]="childNode.width / 2"
                [attr.cy]="childNode.height / 2"
                [attr.rx]="childNode.width / 2"
                [attr.ry]="childNode.height / 2"
              />
            }
            @case ('diamond') {
              <svg:polygon
                class="preview-node"
                [attr.points]="getPreviewShapePoints('diamond', childNode.width, childNode.height)"
              />
            }
            @case ('triangle') {
              <svg:polygon
                class="preview-node"
                [attr.points]="getPreviewShapePoints('triangle', childNode.width, childNode.height)"
              />
            }
            @case ('hexagon') {
              <svg:polygon
                class="preview-node"
                [attr.points]="getPreviewShapePoints('hexagon', childNode.width, childNode.height)"
              />
            }
            @case ('parallelogram') {
              <svg:polygon
                class="preview-node"
                [attr.points]="getPreviewShapePoints('parallelogram', childNode.width, childNode.height)"
              />
            }
            @case ('pentagon') {
              <svg:polygon
                class="preview-node"
                [attr.points]="getPreviewShapePoints('pentagon', childNode.width, childNode.height)"
              />
            }
            @case ('cross') {
              <svg:path
                class="preview-node"
                [attr.d]="getPreviewShapePath('cross', childNode.width, childNode.height)"
              />
            }
            @case ('custom') {
              @if (childNode.customShapeId) {
                <svg:image
                  class="preview-node"
                  [attr.href]="'/assets/' + childNode.customShapeId"
                  [attr.width]="childNode.width"
                  [attr.height]="childNode.height"
                />
              } @else {
                <svg:rect
                  class="preview-node"
                  [attr.width]="childNode.width"
                  [attr.height]="childNode.height"
                  rx="6"
                  ry="6"
                />
              }
            }
            @default {
              <svg:rect
                class="preview-node"
                [attr.width]="childNode.width"
                [attr.height]="childNode.height"
                rx="6"
                ry="6"
              />
            }
          }
          <svg:text
            class="preview-label"
            [attr.x]="childNode.width / 2"
            [attr.y]="childNode.height / 2"
            dominant-baseline="middle"
            text-anchor="middle"
          >
            {{ childNode.label }}
          </svg:text>
        </svg:g>
      }
    </svg:g>
  }
</svg:g>

<!-- External ports -->
@for (port of node().ports; track port.id) {
  @let pos = getPortPosition(port);
  <svg:g class="group-port-container">
    <svg:circle
      class="group-port"
      [class.port-input]="port.type === 'input'"
      [class.port-output]="port.type === 'output'"
      [attr.cx]="pos.x"
      [attr.cy]="pos.y"
      [attr.r]="8"
      [attr.data-port-id]="port.id"
      [attr.data-port-type]="port.type"
      [attr.data-node-id]="node().id"
      (pointerdown)="onPortPointerDown(port, $event)"
    />
    <svg:text
      class="group-port-label"
      [attr.x]="pos.x + (port.type === 'output' ? 15 : -15)"
      [attr.y]="pos.y"
      [attr.text-anchor]="port.type === 'output' ? 'start' : 'end'"
      dominant-baseline="middle"
    >
      {{ getPortLabel(port) }}
    </svg:text>
  </svg:g>
}

<!-- Resize handles (only shown when selected) -->
@if (selected()) {
  @for (handle of getResizeHandles(); track handle.handle) {
    <svg:rect
      class="resize-handle"
      [attr.x]="handle.x"
      [attr.y]="handle.y"
      [attr.width]="8"
      [attr.height]="8"
      [attr.data-resize-handle]="handle.handle"
      [style.cursor]="handle.cursor"
      (pointerdown)="onResizeHandlePointerDown(handle.handle, $event)"
    />
  }
}

components.rawdescription: Presentational component for one graph link. Renders SVG path; supports preview, waypoint handles, path hit area.
components.templateData:
<!-- Hit area: wide transparent stroke for segment grab; receives pointer and click -->
<svg:path
  class="link-path-hit"
  [class.link-selected]="selected()"
  [attr.d]="pathD()"
  fill="none"
  stroke="transparent"
  stroke-width="20"
  vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"
  (pointerdown)="onPathPointerDown($event)"
  (click)="onLinkClick($event)"
  (contextmenu)="onLinkContextMenu($event)"
  (mouseenter)="hovered.set(true)"
  (mouseleave)="hovered.set(false)"
/>
<!-- Visible path -->
<svg:path
  class="link-path"
  [class.link-selected]="selected()"
  [attr.d]="pathD()"
  fill="none"
  [attr.stroke]="previewTarget() ? 'var(--link-preview-stroke, #95a)' : 'var(--link-stroke, #666)'"
  stroke-width="2"
  vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"
  pointer-events="none"
/>
@if ((selected() || hovered()) && !previewTarget()) {
  @for (seg of segmentMidpoints(); track seg.segmentIndex) {
    <svg:circle
      class="segment-handle"
      [attr.cx]="seg.x"
      [attr.cy]="seg.y"
      r="5"
      (pointerdown)="onSegmentMidpointPointerDown($event, seg)"
      (mouseenter)="hovered.set(true)"
      (mouseleave)="hovered.set(false)"
    />
  }
  @for (item of displayWaypoints(); track $index) {
    <svg:g
      (mouseenter)="hovered.set(true)"
      (mouseleave)="hovered.set(false)"
    >
      <svg:circle
        class="waypoint-hit"
        [attr.cx]="item.x"
        [attr.cy]="item.y"
        r="12"
        fill="transparent"
        (pointerdown)="onWaypointHitPointerDown($event, item)"
        (dblclick)="item.pointIndex !== null && onWaypointDoubleClick(item.pointIndex)"
        (contextmenu)="onWaypointHitContextMenu($event, item)"
      />
      <svg:circle
        class="waypoint-handle"
        [class.waypoint-handle-selected]="item.pointIndex !== null && selectedWaypointIndex() === item.pointIndex"
        [attr.cx]="item.x"
        [attr.cy]="item.y"
        r="5"
        pointer-events="none"
      />
    </svg:g>
  }
}

  • Use a higher-level connected component. Storybook helps you compose such data from the "args" of child component stories
  • Assemble data in the page component from your services. You can mock these services out using Storybook.
